migrations: db/migrations

ownership:
  planning_readiness_read: one repeatable-read read-only projection reads existing onboarding draft/profile, accepted slot provenance, and exact selected ACTIVE path; it creates no rows and needs no migration
  learning_workspace_read: one repeatable-read read-only projection reads only the exact Student context plus selected ACTIVE path and ordered item statuses; it creates no rows, receipts, or migration-owned state
  attempt_number: allocated by one INSERT using current max attempt and count
  one_auto_review_per_answer: unique student_task_answer_id with upsert storage
  one_manual_review_per_answer: unique student_task_answer_id with upsert storage
  assessment_choices: replace all rows for an answer inside one transaction
  practice_binding: unique task_answer_id
  teacher_assistance_event: inbox marker, action summary, and target observations commit in one transaction
  teacher_mastery_boundary: assistance observations never update mastery directly
  learning_action_cycle: one active cycle per answer; cycle number is unique within an answer
  learning_action_close: answer status, action closed_at, and learning_action.closed outbox row commit atomically
  learning_action_outcome: official failed/passed outcome and student-mastery-v1 policy are frozen in the same closure transaction but never published to teacher-agent
  objective_mastery_join: assistance inbox, teacher facts, normalized action-target evidence, recomputed projection, and reducer audit commit atomically
  objective_mastery_idempotency: one normalized row and one audit row per action, exact target, and mastery policy
  mastery_concurrency: transaction advisory lock serializes each student and exact target while projection is recomputed from immutable evidence
  learning_path: many ACTIVE rows may exist per student; partial uniqueness permits at most one primary, and the selected context composite foreign key requires an ACTIVE owned path
  learning_journey_version: student_learning_context.version serializes path creation/content/selection/primary/lifecycle mutations and stays stable on replay/no-op
  learning_path_allocation: UUID idempotency and unique planning-request receipts commit with the Student-allocated path ID; exact replay returns the same ID
  learning_path_exact_command: exact path mutation plus immutable request hash/result snapshot receipt commit together; replay returns the stored response and cannot observe or mutate later state
  diagnostic_snapshot: idempotent by student, assessment, and curriculum revision; stores bounded current projection only
  diagnostic_assessment: migration 028 owns five append-only attempt/item/receipt/submission/result tables; attempt id equals plan id, receipt hashes bind exact command identity, immutable plans bind onboarding_version, exact diagnostic-bootstrap-v1 and bootstrap context digest, reservation locks and requires the current onboarding version, and stored plan/items/results are validated on replay without ordinary answer/mastery/path writes; completion atomically inserts the result, completion receipt, and reference-only student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1 trigger into existing migration 014 student_outbox; exact receipt replay inserts nothing and outbox failure rolls completion back
  learning_session: at most one active row per student; metrics and end use optimistic versions
  course_assignment: unique student_id plus course_id; no global uniqueness on student_id
  course_assignment_command: assignment and UUID idempotency receipt commit atomically; planning_request_id is unique
  practice_evidence_command: UUID receipt, immutable exact target rows, recomputed shared mastery projection, and separate audit commit atomically; v2 receipt has a real learning_action_id FK and closes only the matching OPEN Practice binding
  practice_evidence_idempotency: same evidence_id plus request hash replays; different content conflicts; evidence_id equals submission_id
  onboarding_turn: one immutable command receipt is fenced by student, command, and canonical-message identity; accepted effects and slot provenance, or a no_effect proof, commit atomically
  onboarding_path_admission: migration 025 stores immutable reserve/renew/materialize/abort receipts and admission evidence; one Student advisory fence serializes readiness draft/profile writers with every path mutation and admission operation. A partial unique index permits one RESERVED admission per student, while exact readiness rows are locked before materialization writes assignment and selected ACTIVE path.
  practice_learning_action: one existing action aggregate supports immutable source_kind=practice_v2 bindings without a student_task_answer; source kind is immutable in both directions, globally unique task instance, one active owned path/revision binding, immutable task/revision/target/path-position snapshot fields protect provisioning replay, and cancellation stores no evidence or outcome
  lesson_completion: revision-bound per-item immutable requirements and trusted private content, logical successful fact receipts atomically update exact item/path/journey, historical items stay unbound at cutover
migration_history:
  - 001 creates answer and review tables
  - 002 adds answer_payload
  - 003 creates assessment selections
  - 004 renames legacy user tables and creates student position and pet-project runtime tables
  - 005 renames milestone identity to part-milestone identity
  - 006 transactionally renames pet-project runtime schema to practice-task terminology
  - 007 extends assessment rows for ordering and classification
  - 008 snapshots reusable part and milestone IDs into student runtime rows so usage checks never join catalog-owned tables
  - 009 pins a student practice task to the immutable catalog revision returned when it starts
  - 010 pins a solution variant and replaces one-task-per-student uniqueness with one runtime per revision and variant
  - 011 stores numbered project-level final-review submissions, AI status/result, deterministic evidence, and mentor decisions
  - 012 stores one immutable sanitized portfolio snapshot per student practice task with visibility and publication lifecycle state
  - 013 stores the integration inbox plus one teacher assistance summary and curated target observations per learning action
  - 014 stores distinct learning-action cycles, frozen target snapshots, and the durable student outbox; it expands one assistance event to at most 300 indexed target observations
  - 015 freezes task evidence class and official action outcome, then stores normalized objective evidence, current target mastery, and reducer audit
  - 016 stores one independently versioned declared onboarding profile per student
  - 017 stores the current learning path plus immutable revisions, diagnostic snapshots, and learning-session aggregates
  - 018 adds bounded selection, code-run, failure, passed-test, and stuck counters to Student-owned learning sessions
  - 019 stores multiple Course assignments per student plus durable Planner command receipts
  - 020 stores idempotent Practice evidence receipts, immutable exact target evidence, and Practice-specific mastery audit
  - 024 stores immutable Teacher onboarding-turn command receipts and accepted-value provenance; no_effect recovery creates no draft/profile effect
  - 025 stores write-once onboarding-path admissions and operation receipts; exactly one forward SQL migration is selected by the sorted production glob, while the empty-only rollback proof is outside it
  - 026 extends student_learning_action with source/lifecycle union constraints for practice_v2 reservation/open/cancel bindings, backfills legacy Course rows, and never references mutable path items
  - 027 adds v2 Practice evidence receipt/action correlation and digests, preserves readable v1 rows, and permits only atomic OPEN-to-CLOSED passed application bindings without a Course outbox event
  - 028 adds immutable Planner-fixed official diagnostic assessment attempts, frozen task items, submissions, receipts, and placement-only results with exact attempt/plan identity
  - 030 adds deterministic item identity cutover, nullable exact lesson revision, frozen requirements and content, successful activity receipts and exact assessment/Practice correlation
  - 031 enforces immutable assessment/action assignment correlations and successful fact receipts
  - 029 adds student_cancelled for RESERVED/OPEN Practice bindings while keeping practice_provisioning_failed RESERVED-only; NOT VALID preserves historical permissive cancellation rows while enforcing new writes
practice_runtime_identity:
  status: legacy read-only compatibility by default; new v2 rows belong to ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator
  new_rows: student_practice_task_milestone stores practice_task_part_id and practice_task_milestone_id from the catalog runtime context
  legacy_rows: nullable identities fail usage checks closed until an explicit catalog-assisted backfill is performed
revision_pinning:
  new_rows: student_practice_task.practice_task_revision_id is required by the use case and stores the immutable catalog revision selected at start
  legacy_rows: null revision IDs retain the live-context compatibility fallback
solution_variant_pinning:
  new_rows: student_practice_task.practice_task_solution_variant_id stores the selected variant from the pinned revision
  uniqueness: a student may start different variants of the same business task, but not the same variant twice for one revision
final_review:
  uniqueness: one submission_number per student practice task and at most one open pending/blocked review
  completion: review-policy v1 requires mentor approval; AI result is advisory and may be skipped or unavailable without changing deterministic evidence
  deterministic_gate: submission stores normalized results only after all pinned-variant milestone contracts pass a fresh final-mode validation
  retry: mentor changes reopen the referenced final milestone and reject its answer so the existing workspace can be revised
practice_task_publication:
  uniqueness: one publication per student practice task and one opaque share slug per publication
  eligibility: created only after project completion and a passed mentor review that references the exact source artifact
  lifecycle: encrypted file upload as temporary, pending database row, file activation, then ready state; only ready rows are externally readable
  immutability: source archive, checksum, manifest, task revision snapshot, and result snapshot do not change after creation; only visibility and timestamps change
  visibility: private is owner-only, unlisted is share-link-only, public is share-link plus public student listing
  privacy: storage reference, checksum, owner-only exclusion report, and internal row identities are not serialized by public APIs
risks:
  - use-case flows commonly perform multiple repository writes without a shared transaction
  - legacy events and external calls remain non-atomic; learning_action.closed and student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1 use a transactional outbox
  - migration runner serializes sorted SQL application with a PostgreSQL session advisory lock and excludes .down.sql rollback files while preserving legacy .sql and forward .up.sql, and records each source checksum in student_schema_migrations in the same transaction; it refuses to adopt a nonempty schema without that ledger
  - task migrate-down drops only answer and review tables with CASCADE and leaves other owned tables
  - historical migrations do not offer a complete rollback; new Hybrid migration 032 refuses rollback of retained intent/application state
  - mastery policy v1 is cumulative and does not implement time decay, downgrade, corrections, graph propagation, or legacy outcome backfill
verification:
  unit: go test ./... -count=1
  database_integration: go test -tags=integration ./test/integration -count=1; requires approved PostgreSQL environment

testing_policy_dependencies:
  owner: ms-go-student
  lifecycle: scripts/test-policy-postgres.py

  endpoint: generated explicit loopback port; never development database defaults
  full_schema_database: fullschema_student_test
  full_schema_environment: DATABASE_URL
  migration_database: student_migration_test
  migration_environment: STUDENT_MIGRATIONS_TEST_DATABASE_URL
  destructive_opt_in: STUDENT_MIGRATIONS_TEST_ALLOW_SCHEMA_RESET=1 only inside the owned disposable command
  isolation: one generated PostgreSQL instance; schema reset database is distinct from the fully migrated persistence database
  migrations: canonical ms-student-migrate up and status run only against the empty owned full-schema database before native tests
  cleanup: bounded generated Compose project removal including owned volumes; any cleanup failure fails the command
  coverage: registered suites remain PARTIAL; independent lesson-completion proof and NATS bootstrap opt-ins remain unconfigured

  contract: student-planning-snapshot.v1
  repository: LearningJourneyRepoPG.ReadPlanningSnapshot
  transaction: one_repeatable_read_read_only_PostgreSQL_transaction
  migration: 032_hybrid_application_for_optional_pending_intent
  identity: exact_student_owned_path_plus_canonical_requested_target_set_1_to_500
  source: [owned_path_and_context, authoritative_onboarding_profile, ordered_requested_mastery, complete_relevant_ordinary_and_practice_evidence_references, frozen_requirements, activity_fact_references, protected_local_Course_and_Practice_bindings]
  mastery_scope: all_requested_learner_targets_not_only_current_path
  missing_mastery: existing_UNKNOWN_projection_with_zero_counts_not_fabricated_evidence
  history: no_recent_LIMIT_or_silent_truncation
  response_technical_bytes: 134217728
  bounds: preserve_existing_500_items_by_500_requirements_envelope_fail_closed_on_oversize
  applicability: content_addressed_typed_sorted_facets_plus_existing_profile_path_journey_versions
  goal_constraints: coarse_existing_profile_owner_version_no_new_independent_counter
  observation: capture_transaction_time_and_trigger_trace_do_not_alone_change_applicability
  quality_stability: derived_by_Planner_hybrid_replan_v1_from_frozen_evidence_class_source_surface_and_independent_application_kind
  unsupported: [runtime_hold, automatic_adaptation_permission, student_pinning]
  protected: immutable_completed_or_in_progress_item_ids_revisions_requirements_progress_and_local_TaskInstance_associations
  writes: none_no_receipts_reservations_locks_for_mutation_events_or_counter_changes

  canonical_owners: Student_state_and_references_remain_Student_owned_Runtime_lifecycle_remains_Runtime_owned

Hybrid_application_v1:
  migration: 032_hybrid_application
  owner: Student
  intent: durable_exact_request_plus_terminal_consumption_one_live_intent_per_revision
  transaction: admission_fence_sorted_mastery_fences_then_current_READ_COMMITTED_applicability
  revision: targeted_future_rows_and_one_immutable_path_revision_plus_receipt_atomic
  protected: no_delete_reinsert_of_active_or_completed_items
  replay: terminal_receipt_before_current_state_validation
  pending: durable_WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY_no_revision_or_intent_consumption
  rollback: refuse_retained_owner_state
